atomgpt_binning_reference.mismatch: The helper uses nearest-bin replacement and a 0.5-degree default, but actively serializes two decimals. The article is authoritative for 180 values, 0.5 degrees, and three decimals.

benchmark_input.composition: reduced composition from the selected corpus manifest.json, recorded per case as reduced_composition; model_formula is only its checkpoint-specific flattened serialization
benchmark_input.pxrd: 180 max-normalized intensity values on [0, 90) degrees 2theta at 0.5-degree spacing
